steps.title: Prepare wash buffer (1% BSA, 0.05% azide)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g BSA powder and 0.05 g sodium azide in 100 mL 1× PBS, filter through a 0.22 μm syringe filter and store at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Prepare 1× PBS buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve NaCl 137 mM, KCl 2.7 mM, Na₂HPO₄ 10 mM, KH₂PO₄ 1.8 mM in 800 mL H₂O, adjust pH to 7.4 with HCl, bring volume to 1 L, autoclave 20 min and store at room temperature for up to one year.

steps.title: Prepare ACK lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 8.29 g NH₄Cl, 1 g KHCO₃, and 37.2 mg Na₂EDTA to 800 mL H₂O, adjust pH to 7.2–7.4 with 1 N HCl, filter through a 0.2 μm filter and store at room temperature for up to one year.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and isolate femurs
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice with CO₂, pin supine on a foam board with needles, spray with 70 % ethanol, make a hind‑leg incision from foot to groin, pull skin back, cut to expose muscle, remove muscle from knee to groin with scissors, cut knee and groin joints, isolate each femur with intact kneecap and femoral head, remove residual muscle with Kimwipes, repeat for the second leg, and discard carcass according to IACUC protocol #21828.

steps.title: Set up bone‑marrow extraction tubes
steps.instruction: Puncture the bottom of a 0.5 mL microcentrifuge tube from the inside with an 18 G needle, place the tube inside a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, and wear thick protective gloves.

steps.title: Extract bone marrow and lyse red cells
steps.instruction: Cut both ends of each femur with scissors, place femurs into the prepared 0.5 mL tube, centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 10 s at room temperature, discard the 0.5 mL tube, resuspend the pellet in ACK lysis buffer and incubate 2 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash, filter, and count marrow cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, resuspend cells in 1 mL wash buffer, filter through a 70 μm mesh net (or 70 μm filter), count cells, and optionally store at 4 °C for a few hours.

steps.title: Prepare antibody staining solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute CD11b, B220, IgM, and CD19 antibodies 1:99 in wash buffer (CD43 antibody is used undiluted); keep anti‑mouse CD16/CD32 (Fc block) undiluted.

steps.title: Aliquot cells and add Fc block
steps.instruction: Pipette 4 × 10⁶ cells into each 100 μL sample tube (adjust volume with wash buffer to 100 μL), then add 10 μL of the 1:99 diluted Fc‑blocking antibody to every tube.

steps.title: Add antibodies and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 10 μL of each diluted antibody (CD11b, B220, IgM, CD19) and 1 μL undiluted CD43 antibody to the appropriate experimental and control tubes, then incubate in the dark for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash stained cells and add counting beads
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 1,000 × g for 2 min at room temperature, wash twice with 1 mL wash buffer, resuspend in 490 μL wash buffer, invert the tube several times and add 10 μL counting beads.

steps.title: Run flow cytometer with controls and compensation
steps.instruction: Run the no‑stain sample to set laser voltages, run each single‑color control to calculate compensation, run fluorescence‑minus‑one (FMO) controls to verify gating, adjust compensation until bleed‑through is eliminated, then acquire all experimental and control samples.

steps.title: Analyze data and calculate absolute cell numbers
steps.instruction: In FlowJo, gate beads (if used) and live large cells (FSC/SSC), gate CD11b⁺ vs CD11b⁻ to separate myeloid from lymphoid, within CD11b⁻ gate use B220 and CD19 to identify pre‑pro B (B220⁺ CD19⁻) and later stages (B220⁺ CD19⁺), within B220⁺ CD19⁺ use IgM to separate IgM⁻ (pro, small pre, large pre) and IgM⁺ (immature, recirculating) populations, use CD43 expression and FSC to distinguish pro‑B (high CD43), small vs large pre‑B (CD43⁻, FSC low vs high), and B220 intensity to separate mature recirculating (B220^Hi) from immature (B220^Low) IgM⁺ cells. Calculate absolute cell numbers: (events sample / events beads) × (number of beads added / volume of sample).
